data.title: Stablecoin Settlement Pattern Anomaly
data.description: Detect stablecoin transaction patterns consistent with sanctions evasion settlement. Identifies Monday-Friday volume surges with weekend drops (business settlement pattern), transaction clustering to known no-KYC exchange addresses, and volume patterns matching the A7A5 ruble-backed stablecoin profile. Sanctions evasion through stablecoin settlement produces distinctive temporal patterns that mirror traditional business settlement cycles rather than typical retail crypto trading behavior. The weekday-to-weekend volume ratio, combined with clustering of transactions to addresses associated with no-KYC exchanges, provides a high-confidence signal for institutional sanctions evasion activity. This detection establishes rolling baselines for address-level volume patterns and alerts when weekday-weekend ratios and exchange clustering metrics exceed defined thresholds.

enrichment_required.source: Account analytics enrichment (daily volume in USD calculation)
Temporal analytics enrichment (weekday vs weekend volume ratio)

falsepositives: OTC desk activity during business hours
